name: Youth Voice Research Liaison Program
what_you_do: Paid training in how research works, then teens consult with Seattle Children's research teams. They give feedback on study plans and outreach and help share results in youth-friendly ways.
who_can_apply: Students now in grades 10 to 12. Grades 10 and 11 go first. You must have taken at least one science course. You must live close enough to travel to downtown Seattle. You need a device with internet.
duration: Four 1.5-hour training sessions (the 2025 training day was a Saturday, Nov. 1, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.), then monthly 1-hour hybrid sessions and consultations through the year
deadline_text: No application cycle for 2026-27. The next cycle is 2027-28 and dates are not posted. (The 2025-26 deadline was Sept 1, 2025.)
how_to_apply: Online application when the next cycle opens. Check the program page.
notes: Hybrid (virtual and in person). Each research consultation also has a stipend, amount not stated. Breakfast and lunch are provided at the in-person training; students arrange their own transportation. Work permit rule not stated.
